note: Johnson County Conservation park on the Iowa River, half a mile east of Hills. Electric sites 11-14 sit between the loop road and the river bank. Boat ramp (take-out for the Iowa River water trail from Iowa City); bald eagles along the river in winter. --Claude

Riverfront confirmed for sites 11-14. Pin fine. Note rewritten.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront confirmed. The Iowa River is ~90 m wide at the campground (NAIP). The county's site map puts electric sites 11-14 on the river side of the loop road; NAIP shows those pads ~15-25 m from the water with only a narrow tree strip on the bank between (no road, path or day use). The other sites are inside or west of the loop.
SITE COUNT: the county's text says 13 electric + 7 primitive = 20; its site map numbers 14 electric sites (1-14). Kept 20 with a sites note.

WEBSITE: stored mycountyparks link is the booking page; the county's own page for Hills Access is https://www.johnsoncountyiowa.gov/conservation/camping (apply.py does not write website). Phone 319-645-2315 is the park office named in the county's rental contract.
PIN: stored 41.55483,-91.52075 is inside the loop, matching Google's place point (41.5548479,-91.5207465) in the county page link. Fine.
